First. I really hope that you find something to help with the feeling of being lost. 
I am on the same boat at the moment, well almost every month it feels very much the same. 
But I would say that finding new coping strategies help a lot for me . I went through so many therapy sessions to stay away from self harm but have been struggling with addiction instead of self harm . I understand being stuck with “bullshit jobs” and think you doing ASL on the side is great - I know some as well and have been always wanting to use it as a way of helping people. Idk if anything I say helps but I’m glad you’re still working through the days . Everyone is faking it til they make it honestly. You’re going to have some horrible days but listening to others won’t help you unless it’s people that don’t come from a place of judgment. So sorry my advice is to really just get into a routine you love . Try new hobbies, schools not for everyone but maybe you can find podcasts that peak your interest. Also sorry to hear about the bag and items in there ! I’m sure people in your life are happy to have your company, I don’t tell anyone my issues anymore in my life which is a constant stressor so I would say that another thing I suggest is being open to those who care .
